name: fix_dockerfile_layer_order
description: Reorders Dockerfile so dependency install is cached across code changes
prompts: This Dockerfile copies the entire build context (COPY . .) BEFORE running npm install, so any source change invalidates the cache and reinstalls all dependencies. Fix Dockerfile to copy only the dependency manifest(s) first (package.json, and package-lock.json if present), run npm install, and THEN copy the rest of the source - the standard cache-friendly ordering. Keep the base image, WORKDIR, and CMD unchanged.

setup_files.Dockerfile:
FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
# BUG: copying the whole context before installing deps busts the layer
# cache on every source change - npm install re-runs even when only app
# code changed.
COPY . .
RUN npm install
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

reference_solution.Dockerfile:
FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

files.Dockerfile:
FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
RUN npm install
COPY package*.json ./
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
